stopping_rule: Stop after the single planned final fit (feature extraction + SVM) once 5-fold CV on data/train selects the kernel hyperparameters; no further tuning after scoring.

hyperparams.features: unsupervised k-means patch dictionaries (p=6,k=800,stride=2,pool=3x3 and p=4,k=400,stride=2,pool=3x3; ZCA-whitened patches, triangle encoding) + HOG cell8 + HOG cell16, each block L2-normalized
hyperparams.augmentation: horizontal flip and +-4 px shifts (12 variants per training image), flip test-time averaging
hyperparams.classifier: SVC, RBF kernel on precomputed kernel matrix
hyperparams.pca_dims: selected from {none, 1024} by 5-fold CV grouped by source image
